## Handover Summary — CapEx

Programme phased by quarter; Omnium roll-out to associated stores in Trøndelag and Nord-Norge prioritised to remove late POS files.

signals.title: BC API timeout on 2.1M journal lines — Data Lake fallback completed the feed
signals.source: SDP Close Control Tower — ingestion monitor, Business Central GL feed
signals.excerpt: The BC OData API timed out after 1.4M of 2.1M October journal lines. The ingestion agent switched to paged extraction from the Data Lake replica and checked the result against the BC trial balance — no manual workaround this month.
